metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory (1,134 controls; success after 1,014, then 120 unexecuted hold rows of slack). Two fresh-process replays succeed with identical state hashes, and the rows rounded to float32 also succeed. The standard oracle submits the same rows through the public client.

notes.layout: Both hands hang from the same six-axis wrist stage (world-axis slides, then serial X-Y-Z hinges in a fixed rotated gimbal frame), with the same joints, ranges, gains and start targets.
